stories.title: Noreen Niazi moved from Lahore jail to hospital due to high blood pressure: lawyer
stories.brief: LAHORE: Incarcerated PTI founder Imran Khan’s sister Noreen Niazi was moved from Lahore’s Kot Lakhpat jail to the Punjab Institute of Cardiology on Wednesday due to high blood pressure, her lawyer said.

stories.title: Imran Khan’s sister Noreen taken to Punjab Institute of Cardiology after health issue in jail: lawyer
stories.brief: Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI) founder Imran Khan’s sister Noreen Niazi, 70, was admitted to Lahore's Punjab Institute of Cardiology (PIC) on Wednesday following a deterioration in her health while in custody, according to her legal counsel.

stories.title: In support of One-China policy, Pakistan bans Taiwanese airlines from using its airspace: report
stories.brief: He said that Islamabad now only permitted airlines from the People’s Republic of China to fly over Pakistan, excluding Taiwan. According to flight tracking data, Taiwanese carriers began rerouting flights over the weekend, with China Airlines Ltd and Eva Airways Corp no longer flying over Pakistan since Sunday.
